limitations: Before/after is not a controlled single-change causal experiment: corpus, vector alignment and routing changed.

Topic default late-vs-nolate contrasts composite pipelines; pure MaxSim isolated on the 189-query set.
Historical per-query values rounded to four decimals; confidence intervals inherit that precision.
WORKSTATION wall timings include network overhead; component server timings are recorded separately.
